contradictions.description: The 2026-06-30 AP aging totals $9,941.00, while the trial balance reports Accounts Payable of $18,001.15. The unexplained $8,060.15 difference is the residual opening payable after the April 6 payment and is absent from the purported June 30 aging.

w02-accrual_schedule.reason: The May prepaid schedule, insurance and software contracts, and GL provide opening balances, additions, June amortization, closing balances, and the status of the supporting combined entry.

w02-bank_rec.reason: The bank statement, cash GL, source bill, and transaction references provide enough information to identify outstanding checks, deposits in transit, unrecorded bank activity, and the $900 check-recording error and to reconcile both sides uniquely.

w02-journal_entries.reason: The payroll register, prepaid records, fixed-asset register, vendor documents, GL, and checklist establish the required payroll accrual, combined prepaid amortization, depreciation, and vendor-bill reclassification without duplicating posted entries.

w02-variance_analysis.reason: June activity, budget amounts, and the standard close adjustments can be derived from the files. Selection of material variances requires ordinary professional judgment but does not prevent a defensible analysis.
